style: Original art-directed sports poster in a flat screen-print style that stays faithful to the real photograph of the moment: the real jersey colours and numbers, the real arena, the real pose and the real position of every figure, so the moment is recognisable from the picture alone. One dominant colour per poster, hard graphic light, bold flat shapes, vast negative space. Faces are left in shadow or simplified to a few shapes, never a photographic likeness. Jerseys are plain: the number only, with no team name, no wordmark and no lettering across the chest. The picture runs edge to edge with no border, no margin and no caption area, and there is no text of any kind except the jersey numbers: no title, no caption, no credits, no watermark, no logos, no wordmarks.

moments.title: The Bounce
moments.prompt: Game 7, Toronto, 2019: a forward in a black Raptors jersey with a white 2 crouched low on his heels in the right baseline corner, both hands on his knees, mouth open, staring up at the rim, where the ball sits caught mid-bounce on the front of the rim under a shot clock reading 0.0. A tall defender in a white 76ers jersey with a red 21 is still in the air beside him, arm up. The crowd behind is a wall of red. The ball is the one bright object in the frame.

moments.title: From the Logo
moments.prompt: Oklahoma City, overtime, 2016, the shot from the logo. Exactly two players and nobody else. A slight guard in a solid dark navy sleeveless jersey printed with nothing but a large gold number 30 has just released a jump shot from one step past the half-court circle, both arms still up in the follow-through, the ball a small bright sphere high in the air above him on its way to a rim that stands tiny and far away at the top of the frame. One Thunder defender in a solid white jersey trails a few steps behind him, too far away to matter. The whole empty half court lies between the shooter and the basket, the half-court circle under his feet. Navy and gold figure on a pale floor, the crowd a dark band.

moments.title: The Dagger
moments.prompt: Game 7 of the 2016 Finals at Oracle Arena with 53 seconds left: a guard in a black Cavaliers jersey with a gold 2 rising for a step-back three from the right wing, ball above his head at release, while the defender in a white Warriors jersey with a gold 30 lunges late, arm stretched up, off balance. Behind them every seat in the building is yellow. Black and wine-red figures on a field of yellow.

moments.title: The Last Shot
moments.prompt: The 1998 Finals game-winner in Utah: a player in a red road Bulls jersey with a black 23 frozen in a full follow-through at the free-throw line, right arm extended toward the rim, wrist snapped, fingers hanging. To his left a defender in a white Jazz jersey with purple and copper trim stumbles backwards and away, off balance, one hand reaching for the floor. The crowd behind them is a dense dark pattern; the ball is a small sphere halfway to the rim at the top right. Red figure, white defender, near-black crowd.

moments.title: The Shrug
moments.prompt: Game 1 of the 1992 Finals at Chicago Stadium: a player in the white home Bulls jersey with a red 23 jogging back up the floor, shoulders raised, both palms turned up and out in a shrug, head turned to his right toward the courtside broadcast table. Behind him a defender in a black Blazers road jersey. Six basketballs hang as a faint row in the dark above him. White jersey and red numbers on near-black, the hardwood a warm amber.

moments.title: The Flu Game
moments.prompt: The end of Game 5 of the 1997 Finals in Utah: two teammates in red road Bulls jerseys walking off the floor together. The one on the right, with a white 23, is slumped and spent, head hanging, held up by the one on the left, with a white 33, whose arm is wrapped around his shoulders. The crowd behind them is a dense dark pattern. Two red figures with white numbers on black, a sickly green cast in the shadows.

moments.title: The Block
moments.prompt: Game 7 of the 2016 Finals, the chase-down: a player in a black Cavaliers jersey with a gold 23 arriving from behind at full stretch, pinning the ball flat against the backboard glass with his right hand, while the shooter in a white Warriors jersey with a gold 9 is still in the air under the rim at the end of his layup. Behind them a sea of yellow: every seat in Oracle Arena filled with yellow t-shirts. Wine-red, black and gold on yellow, the glass drawn as a thin pale rectangle.

moments.title: The Lob
moments.prompt: Game 7 of the 2000 Western Conference Finals at Staples Center: a huge centre in a gold Lakers jersey with a purple 34 catching an alley-oop above the rim with both hands, mouth open, about to dunk, while the guard in gold with a purple 8 who threw it stands below on the wing with his arm still pointed at the rim. A defender in a black Blazers road jersey is beaten under the basket. Gold and purple figures on a deep purple field.

moments.title: The Skyhook
moments.prompt: The 1985 Finals: a seven-foot centre in a gold Lakers jersey with a purple 33, wearing sports goggles, releasing a skyhook: body turned sideways to the basket, left arm raised as a shield, right arm fully straight above his head, the ball leaving his fingertips at the very top of the frame. A Celtics defender in green with a white 00 reaches up a full head shorter. Gold and purple on black under a single warm spotlight.

moments.title: The Dream Shake
moments.prompt: The 1995 Western Conference Finals: a centre in a red Rockets road jersey with a white 34 on the low block mid-spin, pivoting toward the baseline with the ball tucked at his hip, head turned over his shoulder to find the rim, about to go up, while the defender in a white Spurs jersey with a black 50 is caught leaning the wrong way with his feet crossed. Red and white on black, the floor a pale wedge.

moments.title: The Shot
moments.prompt: Game 5, Cleveland, 1989: a guard in a red road Bulls jersey with a white 23 hanging in the air at the foul line, knees tucked, the ball at the top of a double-clutch release, while the defender in a white Cavaliers jersey with orange and blue trim sails past him with his arm up, already too late. The Richfield Coliseum crowd is a dense dark pattern. Red on near-black, white defender.

moments.title: From the Line
moments.prompt: The 1988 dunk contest at Chicago Stadium: a player in a red Bulls jersey with a black 23 in full flight from the free-throw line, seen in strict side profile, body stretched flat and horizontal, legs split front and back, the ball held high in his right hand with the arm straight, the rim at the right edge of the frame. Below him the free-throw line and the painted key; the stadium is dark and the crowd a black mass pricked with camera flashes. Red figure on black, gold floor lines.

moments.title: The Stepover
moments.prompt: Game 1 of the 2001 Finals at Staples Center. Exactly two players and nobody else. A small guard in a plain white jersey with a black number 3, a black sleeve on his right arm and a white headband, stepping over one defender who lies on his back on the floor in a plain gold jersey with a purple number 10, the guard looking down at him as he passes. Seen from the side at floor level, the courtside seats dark behind, a warm gold floor. One figure standing, one figure down.

moments.title: The Dunk of Death
moments.prompt: Sydney, the 2000 Olympics: a guard in a dark navy USA jersey with a white 9 at the top of his leap, legs spread wide, clearing the head of a seven-foot defender in a white France jersey who ducks beneath him, the ball slammed down one-handed at the rim. Seen from the side, the arena's blue court below. Navy and white on a pale blue field, the crowd dark.
